newsitem.title: CANADA: Kinross to develop Black Hawk gold.
newsitem.headline: Kinross to develop Black Hawk gold.

text.p: Black Hawk Mining Inc said on Thursday it has entered into a deal with Kinross Gold Corp to develop Black Hawk's Hoyle Township gold property near Timmins, Ontario.
The property is on the New Mine Trend, the same trend which includes Kinross's Hoyle Pond and Bell Creek properties.
Black Hawk said drilling on its property will be accelerated and Kinross has committed to spending an additional C$1 million on drilling over the upcoming winter and spring.
Under the deal, Kinross will provide the first C$12 million for development of the property and will manage the project to earn a 50 percent interest in the mine.
A development plan for the property will be completed by the third quarter of 1997, Black Hawk said.
